Contents:

# Check print live test, 2026-10-22

Build: `build/arm64/src/RelWithDebInfo/OrcaSlicer.app` from `claude/check-print-report-82ed92` at e9e8887e6c, copied to the scratchpad and re-signed as bundle id `io.jusprin.check-print-test`, launched with its own `--datadir` (a copy of Kenneth's config with the API keys blanked, agent off). Project: `~/Downloads/arrow_headband.3mf` (its embedded printer is Bambu Lab P1S 0.4 nozzle, not the A1 Kenneth used; nothing below depends on the printer). Later states added plates and objects through the instance's own MCP endpoint.

Evidence directory: `/private/tmp/claude/claude-502/-Users-kenneth-Projects-JusPrin/462562e7-6c9f-4674-844d-00d14db091f3/scratchpad/evidence/` (`evidence/NN-*.jpg` below). Harness bitmaps: `.../scratchpad/harness-capture/` (run log `.../scratchpad/harness-cp.log`, `HARNESS RESULT PASS failures=0`).

How the app was driven: the screen-control route was refused (both the background `app_click` and the display-scope `computer_batch` were aborted; the fork's controls expose no AX actions), so the app was driven by key events posted to its pid and by `lldb` calls into the live process to focus a control or toggle the Legend switch the way a click would (`CheckToggle::toggle()` fires the same wxEVT_CHECKBOX). Screenshots came from the background `app_screenshot` tool. Posted mouse events never reach the app, so anything needing a pointer is under "not tested".

## Kenneth's findings 1–7

**1. Blank white pill, top-left — reproduced, identified.** `evidence/01`, `09`, harness `check-print-canvas-default.png`. It is OrcaSlicer's plate-selector strip (`_render_imgui_select_plate_toolbar`, from `_render_overlays`, GLCanvas3D.cpp:8431), enabled for every editor preview by `GUI_Preview.cpp:276`; `Plater::create_preview` (Plater.cpp:17253) builds the dialog's preview through the same constructor. Blank thumbnail: hypothesis — thumbnails are generated for the Plater's own preview canvas only. Hidden by `set_legacy_overlays_hidden(true)` (GLCanvas3D.cpp:2151).

**2. Navigator cube — reproduced.** `_render_3d_navigator()` GLCanvas3D.cpp:8463, inside `_render_overlays`; same evidence; hidden by the same flag.

**3. Canvas toolbar — reproduced.** `_render_canvas_toolbar()` GLCanvas3D.cpp:8465; same.

**4. Bottom-right layers icon — reproduced, but not the assemble toolbar.** Preview disables that toolbar (GUI_Preview.cpp:280). It is the layer slider's "show one layer" button, drawn by `IMSlider::render` at the canvas's bottom-right (IMSlider.cpp:1273-1285) from `resources/images/one_layer_off.svg` (fills `#009688` and `#fff`; `_on`, `_hover`, `_dark` variants, loaded at IMSlider.cpp:155-162). Drawn from `render_slider`, not `_render_overlays`, so the legacy flag keeps it. Brand colour at no upstream cost: partly — the fork's overlay dir (`resources/jusprin/overlay/images`, BrandPalette.cpp:124) hooks `var()`, but IMSlider builds the path from `resources_dir()` directly, so an overlay copy would not apply; either edit the eight SVGs in `resources/images` in place or change those eight lines to `var(...)`.

**5. "Untitled"/"01" — reproduced; hiding legacy overlays would not remove the number.** `evidence/06`, `09`, `20`. `PartPlate::render_only_numbers` (PartPlate.cpp:3394-3397) runs regardless of `only_body`; the name goes through `render_icons(bottom, only_body, …)` (unverified whether suppressed). Prepare's canvas, with the controller attached, shows both labels too (`evidence/00a`).

Hypothesis check for 1–5: `PreviewPresentationController` (CanvasPresentationController.cpp:84-103) never calls `set_legacy_overlays_hidden`; `attach` does (line 22-23), used by Prepare at ShellController.cpp:609. That explains 1–3 only; 5 not; 4 unaffected.

**6. G-code listing not hidden by Legend — reproduced exactly.** Open (`01`), Legend on (listing moves below the legend, `02`), Legend off (listing back, `03`). Verified: `GCodeWindow::render` is called from `SequentialView::render` whenever a path exists (GCodeViewer.cpp:972) with no legend condition; its gate is `wxGetApp().show_gcode_window()` (GCodeViewer.cpp:810), `GUI_App::m_show_gcode_window{true}` from app-config key `show_gcode_window` (GUI_App.cpp:910). Not inside `_render_overlays` either. Proof: pressing C (GLCanvas3D.cpp:3549) removed it (`09`). The legend's `</>` button calls the same toggle (GCodeViewer.cpp:3470; not pressed, needs mouse). The View menu item is disabled while modal.

**7. Tool-position box over the moves slider, also with Legend off — reproduced.** Select the first finding → box "X 5.390 Y 249.130 Z 0.200 / Speed: 105 Bottom surface" over the slider's left end (`06`); Legend on (`07`) and off (`08`): stays. Verified: drawn when `m_show_marker` (GCodeViewer.cpp:959), at 0.5·width / bottom (line 335); `m_show_marker` set at line 1596 when the visible range's end differs from the full range's end, sticky until the next `load_toolpaths` (line 1388) — so any moves-slider position but the end, and after `show_finding` lowers the layer slider. Quirk: after a keyboard slider move it shows one frame late (line 1596 runs before `render_slider` at 1639; `04`, `05`, lldb `m_show_marker=false` with ranges 347340 vs 347343).

## New findings

**8. Keyboard focus trapped in the canvas.** Tab never leaves the preview (`FindFocus()` stays `GLCanvas`; from the panel it stays `Print report` after three Tabs). Verified: the canvas posts `EVT_GLCANVAS_TAB` (GLCanvas3D.cpp:3747-3750), bound only by the Plater's canvases (Plater.cpp:5185, 5255); the panel has `wxWANTS_CHARS` (CheckPrintReportPanel.cpp:133). Legend and Close are unreachable by keyboard; only Escape works.

**9. Keyboard row selection does not scroll into view.** 22-row report (content 1302 px in 911 px); Up selects the last row (`m_selected={0,21}`, `m_scroll=0`), caption and camera update, highlighted row below the fold (`16`; `17` after forcing the scroll). `select()`/`on_key` never adjust `m_scroll`.

**10. Long report gives no sign it scrolls** — no scrollbar, fade or cut row (`15`). Possibly a design gap.

**11. Caption sits on top of OrcaSlicer's overlays** — over the listing with Legend off (`06`), over the legend's view-type dropdown with Legend on (`07`); `draw_caption` places it at width − 76 DIP, top space_3, and brings it to front.

**12. Window opens with Prepare's camera, not fitted to the plate** — `01` (a corner), `12` (second plate: solid red wall), `15` (cubes plate: empty grey). The constructor never calls `zoom_to_gcode`/`zoom_to_bed`; board 01 shows the whole plate. Closing does restore Prepare's camera.

**13. No minimum window size** — `GetMinSize()` (−1,−1); at 900×600 the moves slider sits under the magnifier button and the navigator overlaps the listing (`13`); 1700×1050 is fine, panel width stays (`14`).

**14. Dark mode: Close button draws a lighter box** (`19`, `20`). `HeaderButton::draw` fills `HeaderStyle::Quiet` with `surface_canvas` (HeaderControls.cpp:~406 and the `fill` expression) while the header is `surface_raised`; the tokens coincide in light, differ in dark. Everything else in dark reads correctly (pink sliders, value boxes, caption, panel).

**15. Stale "40m22s" hover tooltip and ring on the layer slider with no pointer in the window** (`02`, `03`, `04`, `06`). lldb: `ImGui::GetIO().MousePos=(823,102)` while the real pointer was on another display. Hypothesis: the single ImGui context keeps another canvas's last mouse position (570a723ad0 gives each canvas its own size, not its own mouse state), so IMSlider draws the layer-time tooltip (IMSlider.cpp:873-874).

**16. C inside Check print changes and persists the app-wide "Show G-code Window" preference** — `JusPrin2.conf` flipped to `"show_gcode_window": false` (GLCanvas3D.cpp:3549 → GUI_App.cpp:716-719); same for the legend's `</>` button.

**17. Verified behaviour (not bugs):** panel follows the active plate across three plates (`12`, `15`, `19`); an MCP setting change while open closed the window within 2 s; Escape closes from canvas and panel; summary matches the legend (40m22s / 5.74 m / 18.22 g / 0.46 vs 40 min / 5.7 m / 18 g / $0.46); section order held (harness Supports first; warnings red → islands amber → first layer; live Crossing paths red → First layer); closing lines named exactly the checks not shown; five openings across two instances with re-slices between — no crash, no assertion, only OrcaSlicer's own `[error]` lines in the log.

## Deviations from the boards (not filed)
No "Moves slider" checkbox (deliberate per the commit message); caption title in ImGui's regular font vs `label-bold`; Supports count "43 layers" vs "2 objects · 96 layers".

## Side observations outside Check print (lower confidence)
Cmd+R switches the main window to OrcaSlicer's Preview tab with all its overlays (`00`, `18`). The print-actions popup stayed open with stale rows while a slice finished underneath ("Slice all plates" while the primary read "Print plate 2", `11`); a posted Escape did not close it — keys were posted, not typed, so a lead only.

## Not reproduced / not tested, and why
- Mouse-driven checks (slider drag, wheel over the slider, row hover, clicking rows/headers/Close, legend buttons): no pointer route; keyboard/lldb equivalents used; harness covers `panel.select`, `toggle_section`, the switch.
- Two filaments: one slot in the project, `printer_setup_preview` refused a second preset, no keyboard route to add a slot; harness has no case either; per-extruder rows and "Changes" row untested.
- Supports section live: harness only (cp_b PASS, `check-print-supports.png`).
- Undo/redo while modal: not tried.
- Opening on a small main window: resized the dialog itself instead (13).
- Row-level ellipsis of long object names: no long name available; caption ellipsis seen in the harness, two-line wrapping seen live (`19`).</result>

The live round is in, and it changed three of my earlier identifications. The full report with evidence paths is at [check-print-live-bugs.md](.claude/worktrees/check-print-report-82ed92/check-print-live-bugs.md), untracked in the branch's worktree. Here is the proposal, grouped by what it costs upstream.

**What the round found.** All seven of your items reproduced. Three corrections to what I said before: the bottom-right icon is the layer slider's own one-layer-mode button, not an overlay; the "01" plate number is drawn even when overlays are hidden, so Prepare shows it too; and the G-code listing and tool-position box are independent of the legend in OrcaSlicer itself, which is why the toggle leaves them. Nine new bugs: Tab never leaves the canvas, so Legend and Close are unreachable by keyboard; keyboard row selection does not scroll the panel; a long report shows no sign it scrolls; the finding caption lands on top of the listing or the legend; the window opens with Prepare's camera instead of fitting the plate; there is no minimum window size, so at 900 by 600 the overlays collide; the Close button draws a lighter box in dark mode; a stale hover tooltip from Prepare's last pointer position shows on the layer slider; and pressing `c` inside the window permanently flips the app-wide G-code-window preference. Panel contents, plate following, auto-close on a settings change, and the summary totals all checked out against OrcaSlicer's own numbers.

**Fixes with no upstream lines, all in fork code**

- Hide OrcaSlicer's overlay layer in the window the way Prepare does, which removes the plate strip, the navigator cube and the canvas toolbar.
- Turn the G-code window off while Check print is open and restore the person's setting on close. That also fixes the `c` key persisting the preference.

Fix round for the Check print window on claude/check-print-report-82ed92. Kenneth decided the plan after a live test of the built app: fix everything below in fork code, with zero new upstream lines. The full bug report with evidence paths is untracked in your worktree root: `check-print-live-bugs.md` (evidence JPGs and harness PNGs under `/private/tmp/claude/claude-502/-Users-kenneth-Projects-JusPrin/462562e7-6c9f-4674-844d-00d14db091f3/scratchpad/evidence/` and `.../scratchpad/harness-capture/`). Read it first; the numbering below matches it.

THREE THINGS TO LEAVE AS THEY ARE (decided)
- The tool-position box ("X … Y … Speed … Gap infill") that OrcaSlicer draws at the bottom centre while a slider is not at the end of the print: keep.
- The plate name and number on the bed ("Untitled", "01"): keep; Prepare shows them too.
- The layer slider's one-layer-mode button at the bottom right, in OrcaSlicer teal: keep as is. (Its SVGs are loaded through `resources_dir()` not `var()`, so the overlay cannot recolour it without upstream lines.)

FIXES, ALL IN FORK CODE
1–3. Plate-selector strip (the blank white pill top-left), 3D navigator cube and canvas toolbar in the window: `PreviewPresentationController` must hide OrcaSlicer's legacy overlay layer the way Prepare's controller does (`set_legacy_overlays_hidden(true)` on attach, restore the previous value on destroy). Verify the three are gone and nothing else changes.
6 and 16. The G-code listing stays on regardless of the Legend checkbox because it is gated by the app-wide `GUI_App::show_gcode_window()` (default true, persisted in the app config), not by the legend. In the dialog: remember the setting on open, force it off (through the existing toggle so the viewer repaints), and restore the remembered value on close, including the stale-close and Escape paths. That also fixes 16, where the `c` key inside the window permanently flipped the preference: the restore puts it back. If the person turns the listing on inside the window with `c` or the legend's code button, that is their explicit action; leave it on until close.
8. Keyboard focus is trapped in the canvas: the canvas posts `EVT_GLCANVAS_TAB` (GLCanvas3D.cpp around 3747) and only the Plater binds it. Bind it in the dialog to move focus to the report panel, and give the panel Tab handling that reaches the Legend checkbox and the Close button and back to the canvas. Escape must keep working from every focus.
9. Keyboard selection in the report does not scroll the selected row into view: adjust the panel's scroll in `select()` / key handling so the highlighted row is visible.
10. A long report gives no sign it scrolls: draw a scrollbar from the design tokens (thin track and thumb, surface-subtle track, border-strong thumb, radius-small; no literals) and make the wheel scroll it. If you think the design needs a different affordance, draw the simplest one and say so.
11. The finding caption sits on top of OrcaSlicer's G-code listing and, with Legend on, on the legend's dropdown: move it to the top-left corner of the canvas, which is empty once the overlays are hidden; keep the inset from tokens. Also set its title in the bold label style instead of ImGui's regular font.
12. The window opens with Prepare's camera: on open, fit the camera to the sliced plate (the preview's zoom-to-G-code path), and keep restoring Prepare's camera on close as it already does.
13. No minimum window size: set a minimum from one-off constants (this window's values are allowed to be one-off) so the preview, both sliders and the panel never collide; the 900×600 case in the report must look right.
14. Dark mode: the Close button draws a lighter box because `HeaderButton` in the Quiet style fills with surface-canvas while this header is surface-raised. Fix it so the quiet button takes the surface it sits on; check the Agent pane header and every other HeaderButton user still look right in both modes.
15. A stale hover tooltip and hover ring show on the layer slider with no pointer in the window: the shared ImGui context keeps the last pointer position of Prepare's canvas. Reset the pointer state for the dialog's canvas when it takes over (the ImGui wrapper's existing mouse-update path, or a synthetic leave); investigate first, fork code only; if it truly needs an upstream line, stop and report instead of adding one.
Also from the report's deviations list: the Supports section count should read like the board ("2 objects · 96 layers"), not "43 layers".

DONE LOOKS LIKE
Every numbered item above has a harness check in `tests/shell/check_print_scenario.inc` where the harness can observe it (overlay flags, show_gcode_window before/during/after, focus after Tab, scroll offset after keyboard selection, caption position, camera fitted, min size, Close button fill in dark, no hover state without a pointer), plus Catch2 coverage where the logic is in the model or panel. Re-render the harness bitmaps for the default, legend-on, selected-finding and dark states and look at them. Build with -j4 after checking the load (`uptime`, `pgrep -fl ninja`). Commit as a small number of clean commits on the branch with messages a cold reader understands; squash fixups yourself since Kenneth has already approved rewriting this branch's history for that. Do not push. Final message: what changed per item, what the harness proves, what remains untestable without a pointer, and confirmation that the upstream footprint is unchanged at the 16 lines (Color.hpp, ImGuiWrapper, IMSlider, GLCanvas3D).
